title: verify_user_registration_with_valid_and_invalid_data
description: Test the /api/auth/register endpoint to ensure users can register with valid data including email, password, name, admission number, and graduation year. Verify proper error handling for missing or invalid fields.

title: verify_user_login_with_correct_and_incorrect_credentials
description: Test the /api/auth/login endpoint to verify that users can log in with correct email and password, and receive JWT tokens. Confirm that login fails with incorrect credentials.

title: verify_access_token_refresh_functionality
description: Test the /api/auth/refresh-token endpoint to ensure that users can refresh their access tokens using valid refresh tokens and that invalid or expired tokens are rejected.

title: verify_user_logout_clears_session_and_tokens
description: Test the /api/auth/logout endpoint to confirm that user sessions and tokens are properly invalidated upon logout.

title: verify_get_current_user_profile
description: Test the /api/auth/me endpoint to ensure that authenticated users can retrieve their current profile information correctly.

title: verify_password_reset_request_and_token_generation
description: Test the /api/auth/forgot-password endpoint to verify that users can request a password reset and receive a valid reset token.

title: verify_password_reset_with_valid_and_invalid_tokens
description: Test the /api/auth/reset-password endpoint to ensure users can reset their password using a valid token and that invalid or expired tokens are handled properly.

title: verify_password_change_for_authenticated_users
description: Test the /api/auth/change-password endpoint to confirm that authenticated users can change their password by providing the current and new passwords.

title: verify_admin_can_get_all_users
description: Test the /api/users GET endpoint to ensure that only admin users can retrieve the list of all users.

title: verify_admin_can_approve_pending_users
description: Test the /api/users/:id/approve PATCH endpoint to verify that admin users can approve pending user registrations.
